# Harlow & Stone Landscapes

> Premium landscape design-build firm composing complete outdoor environments
> for Utah estates and architecturally-significant homes — full landscape
> installations, retaining walls, sport courts, hardscape, outdoor lighting,
> water features, irrigation, and long-term stewardship.

## About

Harlow & Stone is the design-led landscape practice within a Utah construction
family with two decades of work on the Wasatch Front. The firm is deliberately
small. Each project is led from concept through construction by the same
designer, built by our own crews, and cared for by the team that built it —
nothing is brokered, nothing is handed off.

- Region: Utah — Wasatch Front
- Cities served: Salt Lake City, Park City, Holladay, Sandy, Draper, Alpine,
  Highland, Lehi, Cottonwood Heights, Bountiful, Farmington, Heber City,
  Midway, Pleasant Grove, Provo
- Counties served: Salt Lake, Utah, Summit, Davis, Wasatch
- Price tier: high-end / luxury ($$$$)

## Capabilities

- Full landscape installation — complete property design + build
- Landscape design & master planning
- Retaining walls — segmental, boulder, board-formed concrete, drystack stone
- Hardscape — patios, terraces, drives, walks, masonry walls, fire features
- Sport courts — pickleball, half-courts, putting greens
- Softscape — trees, perennial layers, native restoration, lawn
- Outdoor lighting — low-voltage architectural lighting design + install
- Water features — basins, scuppers, plunge pools, stream restoration
- Irrigation — water-conscious drip systems with smart controls
- Stewardship — seasonal care, horticultural service, systems maintenance,
  hardscape inspection

## Frequently asked

### Where does Harlow & Stone work?
Across Utah's Wasatch Front — Salt Lake, Utah, Summit, Davis, and Wasatch
counties — with most work concentrated in Park City, Holladay, Alpine, Draper,
and the Salt Lake City east bench.

### What is a typical project size?
The firm focuses on full-scope residential landscapes: estate properties,
new-build homes, and complete reimaginings of existing grounds. Smaller scopes
(a single retaining wall, a sport court, a hardscape phase) are taken on
when they make sense for the property and the schedule.

### Do you handle long-term care?
Yes. Stewardship is part of the practice. We stay with the landscapes we
build — through their first decade and beyond — with seasonal walks,
horticultural care, irrigation tuning, lighting service, and hardscape
inspection.

### Are you part of a larger company?
Yes. Harlow & Stone is the landscape firm within the Alpine Fence & Deck
family of companies — twenty years of construction craft on the Wasatch Front,
under one accountability line.
